prompts.scenario: You recently returned from a semester abroad in Spain. Registration for next semester's classes opens in two days. Dear Mr. Henderson,

I hope this email finds you well. I am contacting you urgently because my course registration window opens in two days, and the online portal is blocking me from enrolling in the required Senior Capstone Seminar. The system states that I am missing the prerequisite course.

Thank you for your assistance,

Jordan Smith
